note: Maps a CICIoMT2024 capture device to a simulated clinical device in the Mininet topology. Required because the WiFi profiling captures are consumer IoT hardware, while contracts/devices.json names clinical equipment. Per contracts/README.md rule 5, device_id comes from the topology, not the dataset. Each mapping is justified by behavioural similarity, not by device purpose.

SenseU.justification: continuous periodic telemetry at a steady low rate, matching a ventilator's status reporting

Singcall.justification: low-rate intermittent event traffic, matching dose-event reporting

Multifunctional_Pager.justification: event-driven bursts against an otherwise quiet baseline

Ecobee_Camera.justification: continuous high-rate stream, matching waveform telemetry

M1T_Camera.justification: periodic bursts separated by idle gaps, matching cuff-cycle measurement

Owltron_Camera.justification: sustained bidirectional traffic with many peers

Blink_Camera.justification: mixed LAN and WAN traffic, matching an administrative host

Blink_Mini_Camera.justification: second capture of the same administrative profile
